blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Diffusion language models generate by iteratively denoising a masked sequence under bidirectional attention, without the strict left-to-right commitment of autoregressive decoding. Whether this difference affects how reliably they remain grounded in structured inputs is largely unexplored. We study this question in table-to-text generation using ToTTo, where highlighted source cells make factual grounding directly testable. We compare the masked diffusion models MDLM and LLaDA with GPT-2 and GPT-Neo under an identical retrieval-based few-shot protocol, together with a QLoRA-adapted LLaDA, and we score reference similarity and source grounding as separate axes. The two pull apart. Within LLaDA, additional demonstrations raise BLEU from 11.3 to 22.0 while NLI entailment against the source table falls from 0.78 to 0.52; QLoRA reaches the best BLEU of the study, 24.15, and grounds no better for it. Manual annotation shows the failure modes differ in kind: the autoregressive baselines tend to wander off the table, while LLaDA-based models more often stay on topic and swap out individual entities. Reference-based metrics alone are insufficient to assess faithfulness in table-to-text generation.
blocks.zh: 在双向关注下通过迭代去除被遮掩的序列来产生分化语言模型,而无需严格地从左到右地承诺自旋分解. 这一差别是否影响到它们在多大程度上仍然以结构化的投入为基础,这一点基本上没有得到探讨。 我们用TOTTo在表格到文本生成中研究这个问题,其中突出的源细胞使事实可以直接验证。 我们根据一个相同的基于回取的数发协议,将蒙面扩散模型MDLM和LLaDA与GPT-2和GPT-Neo进行对比,加上一个由QLORA适应的LLaDA,我们得分参照相似性和源地基作为独立的轴. 二者相去相去来. 在LLaDA内,其他示威活动将BLEU从11.3提高到22.0,而NLI对源表的影响从0.78下降到了0.52;QLORA达到了研究中最好的BLEU,24.15,而且没有更好的依据。 手动注释显示故障模式在实物上有所不同:自旋基线往往会从表格上走出,而基于LLaDA的模型则更经常地停留在话题上并互换出单个实体. 仅基于参考的衡量标准不足以评估表格到文本生成中的忠诚度。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Tables are among the most common structured elements found in real-world documents, from financial reports to scientific papers, making faithful table-to-text generation a prerequisite for reliable document-grounded reasoning. Natural language generation has long been dominated by autoregressive language models, which generate text sequentially from left to right Radford et al. (2019) . Diffusion-based language models have recently emerged as a fundamentally different alternative, generating text through iterative denoising under bidirectional attention Şuayp Talha Kocabay and Akkuş (2026) . MDLM Sahoo et al. (2024) first showed that masked diffusion models could approach autoregressive perplexity on language-modeling benchmarks; LLaDA Nie et al. (2025) extended this line of work well beyond perplexity. Nevertheless, one question remains unexplored: can diffusion language models be trusted to generate text that is faithful to a structured input source?
blocks.zh: 表格是现实世界文件中最常见的结构要素之一,从财务报告到科学论文,使忠实的表格到文本生成成为可靠文件依据推理的先决条件。 自然语言生成长期以自动递归语言模型为主,这些模型从左到右的拉德福德等人(2019年)依次生成文字. 以传播为基础的语言模型最近作为一种根本不同的选择出现,在双向关注下通过迭代调试生成文本 Şuayp Talha Kocabay和Akkuş (2026年). MDLM Sahoo 等人(美国) (2024)首先表明,蒙面扩散模型可以在语言模型基准上处理自旋性偏差;LLaDA Nie等人. (2025年)这一条工作线的延伸远远超出了困惑. 尽管如此,仍有一个问题尚未探讨:能否信任传播语言模型生成忠实于结构化输入源的文本?

blocks.en: To investigate this question, we need a setting where faithfulness violations are unambiguous and objectively verifiable. Table-to-text generation provides exactly this testbed. Early table-to-text benchmarks such as WikiBio Lebret et al. (2016) suffered from reference divergence from the source table Dhingra et al. (2019) . ToTTo Parikh et al. (2020) addressed this by having models describe only a highlighted subset of table cells. Prior work on ToTTo, however, has relied on fine-tuned models such as T5 Kale and Rastogi (2020) and BART Lewis et al. (2020) , evaluated with lexical metrics. Krylov and Somov Krylov and Somov (2024) adapt the continuous encoder–decoder diffusion model GENIE and show it matches fine-tuned T5 baselines on BLEU, PARENT and BLEURT while offering a better quality–diversity trade-off. Their study, however, treats table grounding as one quality score among several. We ask a different question. We take faithfulness as the object of study rather than a metric.
blocks.zh: 为了调查这一问题,我们需要有一个不含糊和客观可核查的违反忠诚行为的环境。 表格到文本生成提供了精确的这个测试台. 早期的表格对文本基准,如WikiBio Lebret等人(2016年),与来源表Dhingra等人(2019年)存在参考差异。 ToTto Parikh等人(2020年)通过只有模型来描述表格单元格中突出的子集来解决该问题。 然而,之前关于TOTTo的工作依赖于T5 Kale和Rastogi(2020年)和BART Lewis等人等微调模型. (2020年),以词典计量法评价. Krylov和Somov Krylov和Somov(2024年)调整了连续编码器-编码器扩散模型GENIE,并显示它与BLEU、PENT和BLEURT上经过微调的T5基线相吻合,同时提供更好的质量-多样性权衡。 然而,他们的研究将表垫作为几个质量分数中的一个。 我们问了一个不同的问题。 我们把忠诚作为研究的目标,而不是衡量标准。

blocks.en: Hallucination is commonly split into intrinsic errors (contradicting the source) and extrinsic errors (introducing unsupported content) Ji et al. (2023) . Lexical metrics like BLEU/ROUGE reward reference similarity regardless of grounding Dhingra et al. (2019) , motivating our use of NLI-based entailment Laban et al. (2022) as a source-grounded faithfulness score.

blocks.en: Piskorz et al. (2025) raise concerns that the training objective underlying masked diffusion alters the inductive biases familiar from autoregressive models in ways that may limit a model’s ability to attend to and faithfully reproduce specific input content.
blocks.zh: Piskorz等人(2025年)担心,蒙面传播背后的培训目标会改变自递式模型所熟悉的诱导性偏差,可能限制模型处理和忠实复制具体输入内容的能力。

blocks.en: We make three contributions: (i) we evaluate masked discrete diffusion models (MDLM, LLaDA) rather than continuous-space diffusion, in the frozen few-shot regime rather than after task-specific fine-tuning; (ii) we score reference similarity and source grounding on separate axes and show they diverge systematically – within a single model, adding in-context demonstrations improves BLEU while reducing entailment against the source table, and QLoRA improves aggregate lexical scores without yielding statistically significant gains in source faithfulness after correction for multiple comparisons; and (iii) we characterize how the paradigms fail, not just how often, showing a shift from coarse topic drift in the autoregressive baselines to localized entity substitution in LLaDA-based generations.
blocks.zh: 我们做出了三项贡献:(一) 我们评价被遮掩的离散扩散模型(MDLM,LLaDA),而不是在被冻结的几弹制中,而不是在针对特定任务的微调后进行连续的空间扩散;(二) 我们得分参照相似性和源头,并系统显示它们的差异 — — 在一个单一模型中,增加内容内演示可以改善BLEU,同时减少对源表的暗示;以及QLORA在经过多次比较修正后,在源的可靠性方面改进了总的词汇分数,而不会产生统计上的重大收益;(三) 我们描述范式是如何失败的,而不只是多少时候,显示从自递性基线中粗糙的话题转向基于LLADA的代中的地方实体替代。

blocks.en: 2 Experimental Setup and Results
blocks.zh: 2 实验设置和结果

blocks.en: 2.1 Dataset
blocks.zh: 2.1 数据集

blocks.en: We conduct experiments on the ToTTo benchmark introduced by Parikh et al. (2020) and only the highlighted cells were retained. We transformed each structured table into a textual representation prior to inference. Each processed instance consists of three fields: (i) a table identifier, (ii) the serialized table representation, and (iii) the reference description from the dataset.
blocks.zh: 我们对Parikh等人(2020年)提出的Totto基准进行实验,只保留了突出的细胞。 在推论之前,我们把每个结构化的表格变成文字代表。 每个已处理实例包括三个字段:(一) 表格标识符;(二) 序列式表格表示符;(三) 数据集的参考说明。

blocks.en: We constructed a training subset containing 5,000 examples and a validation subset containing 500 examples, extracted from the official ToTTo training and development splits, respectively.
blocks.zh: 我们构建了一个包含5 000个实例的培训子集和一个包含500个实例的验证子集,分别从正式的TOTTo培训和开发拆分中提取。

blocks.en: 2.2 Language Models
blocks.zh: 2.2 语文模式

blocks.en: We explore whether masked diffusion language models can produce faithful descriptions of structured data. We first tested MDLM Sahoo et al. (2024) before focusing on LLaDA Nie et al. (2025) . We evaluate the two models in a few-shot setting with k ∈ { 0 , 1 , 3 , 5 , 10 } k\in\{0,1,3,5,10\} in-context examples ( k = 0 k=0 : zero-shot), each constructed by prepending k k randomly sampled “Table/Description” pairs to the target table. We then fine-tune LLaDA on the training set.

We study then the text generation from representative autoregressive baselines. Table 1 summarizes the characteristics of the evaluated models. All models are evaluated under the same prompting protocol and in-context learning settings.

The effect of in-context learning varies markedly across models.
GPT-2 and GPT-Neo reach their highest BLEU scores with a single

QLoRA adaptation further increases the best BLEU to 24.15, although
additional demonstrations do not provide monotonic improvements.

model-dependent and that, for LLaDA-based models, most of the
reference-based gain is obtained with only a small number of
demonstrations.

blocks.en: 3 Discussion and Limitations
blocks.zh: 3. 讨论和限制

blocks.en:
Our experiments provide, to our knowledge, the first empirical
comparison between this set of autoregressive and diffusion language
models on a structured table-to-text benchmark from the perspective
of faithfulness. LLaDA-based models achieve substantially higher
BLEU, ROUGE, and BERTScore than the considered autoregressive
baselines and MDLM. QLoRA further improves the best aggregate BLEU
and ROUGE-L scores. However, paired statistical testing shows that
these improvements over pretrained LLaDA are not significant at the
example level for sentence-level BLEU, ROUGE-L, or BERTScore after
Holm correction.

BLEU. This is particularly pronounced at 1-shot, where the difference
in both entailment and contradiction remains significant after correction
for multiple comparisons. Together with the manual evaluation, these
results suggest that task adaptation can improve agreement with
reference descriptions without necessarily reducing factual errors.
Reference-based metrics alone are therefore insufficient for evaluating
faithfulness in table-to-text generation.
blocks.zh:
更重要的是,改进后的参考相似性没有系统性
意味着改善源底。 以源头为依据的NLI评价
表明经过培训的LLADA能够实现更高的水平
尽管总和较低,但所涉费用低于其QLORA调整后的对应费用
布莱克。 这一点在一弹中尤为明显,其中区别在于
在纠正后,两者的产生和矛盾仍然很大。
用于多重比较。 连同手工评估,
结果表明,任务调整可以改善与
参考说明不一定减少事实错误。
因此,仅靠参考衡量标准不足以进行评价
忠实于表格到文本生成。

blocks.en:
The qualitative analysis further supports this observation. Rather than
simply differing in the frequency of hallucinations, the evaluated
models also differ in their failure modes. The autoregressive baselines
frequently produce severe failures such as topic drift, prompt leakage,
or unrelated generations. In contrast, LLaDA-based generations
generally remain more closely aligned with the input table and produce
fluent descriptions, while their remaining errors are often localized,
such as entity substitutions. QLoRA does not eliminate these errors
and, in our manual sample, increases the frequency of entity
substitutions. These findings motivate evaluating not only whether a
generation is incorrect, but also the type and severity of its factual
errors.
blocks.zh:
定性分析进一步支持这一看法。 而不是说
仅仅在幻觉的频率上有所不同
模型的故障模式也有所不同。 自动递减基线
经常产生严重的故障,如主题漂移、迅速渗漏,
或无关的世代。 相反,LLaDA的几代人
通常与投入表保持更紧密的一致并产生
流利的描述,虽然它们剩下的错误往往是局部的,
例如实体替换。 QLORA 不消除这些错误
并且,在我们的手工样本中,增加实体的频率
替换。 这些结论不仅促使评估是否
生成不正确,但事实的种类和严重性
错误。

blocks.en: Our study nevertheless presents limitations. First, our experiments are conducted exclusively on ToTTo; extending this evaluation to other structured generation benchmarks (e.g. WikiBio, domain-specific data-to-text tasks) would test the generality of our findings.
blocks.zh: 然而,我们的研究是有局限性的。 首先,我们的实验完全在TOTTo上进行;将这一评价扩大到其他结构化的生成基准(如WikiBio,特定域的数据到文本任务)将测试我们的调查结果的概括性.

blocks.en: Second, our comparison is limited to a small set of open-source models reproducible on a single GPU; larger and instruction-tuned systems were excluded to preserve reproducibility. Our conclusions are therefore specific to the models studied here and should not be extrapolated to the autoregressive or diffusion paradigms as a whole.
blocks.zh: 第二,我们的比较仅限于在单一GPU上可复制的一小组开源模型;排除了更大的和指令调制的系统来保存可复制性. 因此,我们的结论是针对本文所研究的模型的,不应推论为整个自动递减或扩散模式。

blocks.en: Finally, faithfulness itself remains an open evaluation problem. While NLI-based entailment captures aspects of factual consistency that lexical metrics fail to detect, our qualitative analysis shows that fluent generations containing subtle entity substitutions may still receive relatively high automatic scores. Developing evaluation protocols capable of distinguishing different types of factual errors therefore remains an important direction for future research.
blocks.zh: 最后,忠诚本身仍然是一个公开的评价问题。 虽然基于NLI的必然结果捕捉了词汇衡量标准无法检测到的事实一致性的方面,但我们的定性分析表明,含有微妙实体替代的流利世代仍然可能获得相对较高的自动分数。 因此,制定能够区分不同类型事实错误的评价规程仍然是今后研究的一个重要方向。

blocks.en:
Our manual evaluation focuses on factual errors
expressed in generated text rather than exhaustive
coverage of source information. Consequently,
the reported categories do not directly quantify
omissions of relevant table content. Evaluating
information coverage alongside factual consistency
remains an important direction for future work.
blocks.zh:
我们的人工评估集中在事实错误上
以生成的案文表示,而不是详尽无遗
涵盖源信息。 因此,
报告类别没有直接量化
相关表格内容的省略。 评价
信息覆盖与事实一致性
仍然是今后工作的一个重要方向。

blocks.en: 4 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 4 结论

blocks.en:
We presented a diagnostic study of autoregressive and diffusion
language models for table-to-text generation on ToTTo. LLaDA-based
models achieve substantially stronger reference-based performance than
the considered GPT-2, GPT-Neo, and MDLM baselines, with
LLaDA+QLoRA obtaining the highest aggregate BLEU score.
blocks.zh:
我们提出了关于自递性和传播的诊断研究
TOTTo上的表格到文本生成语言模型。 基于 LLaDA
模型的参考性能比
考虑的GPT-2、GPT-Neo和MDLM基线
LLaDA+QLORA获得BLEU总分最高.

blocks.en:
However, source-grounded NLI evaluation, statistical testing, and
manual error analysis show that stronger reference similarity does not
systematically imply greater factual faithfulness. In particular, QLoRA
improves aggregate lexical scores without providing statistically
significant gains over pretrained LLaDA on the tested sentence-level
reference metrics, while faithfulness can deteriorate in selected
settings. These results highlight the need to evaluate structured text
generation using source-grounded factuality measures alongside
conventional reference-based metrics.
blocks.zh:
然而,基于来源的NLI评价、统计测试和
手动错误分析显示,较强的引用相似性不会
系统地意味着更加忠实于事实。 特别是,QLORA
在不提供统计数据的情况下改进集合语法分数
在经测试的刑期一级比预先培训的LLADA有显著收益
参考衡量标准,而忠诚度在选定的
设置。 这些结果突出了评价结构化文本的必要性。
使用基于源的事实计量
常规参考度量衡。

blocks.en: Retrieved demonstrations are selected using dense retrieval. Each serialized table is embedded using the sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 encoder. Cosine similarity is then computed between the target table and all training examples, and the top- k k nearest neighbours are selected. To ensure fair comparisons across in-context learning settings, nested retrieval is employed: the 3-shot prompt contains the first three examples of the 10-shot retrieval set, while the 5-shot prompt extends the same ordering. blocks.en: Appendix C Experimental Setup & Hyperparameters
blocks.zh: 附录C 设置超参数( H)

blocks.en: This appendix reports the implementation details and hyperparameters used throughout all experiments. Unless otherwise specified, identical experimental settings were adopted for all models to ensure a fair comparison.
blocks.zh: 本附录报告在所有试验中使用的实施细节和超参数。 除非另有规定,所有模型都采用了相同的实验设置,以确保公平比较。

blocks.en: C.1 Dataset
blocks.zh: C.1 数据集

blocks.en: All experiments were conducted on the ToTTo benchmark. The evaluation protocol follows the official train/evaluation split. During inference, only the evaluation subset was used for testing, while the training subset served exclusively as the retrieval corpus for in-context learning.
blocks.zh: 所有试验都是在Totto基准上进行的。 评价协议遵循正式的列车/评价分期执行。 在推论期间,只有评价子集用于测试,而培训子集则专门作为内容内学习的检索工具。

blocks.en: For each evaluation example, dense retrieval was performed over the training set to construct nested in-context demonstrations for the 1-shot, 3-shot, 5-shot and 10-shot settings.
blocks.zh: 在每个评价实例中,在为一发、三发、五发和十发设置搭建嵌入式文字演示的训练集中进行了密集检索。

blocks.en: C.2 Dense Retrieval
blocks.zh: C.2 紧急检索

blocks.en: Relevant demonstrations were retrieved using the pretrained encoder sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 . Each serialized table was encoded into a dense embedding, L2-normalized, and cosine similarity was computed against all training examples. The top- k k nearest neighbours were selected to construct the in-context examples.
blocks.zh: 使用事先训练过的编码器句子转换器/全MiniLM-L6-v2检索了相关的演示。 每个序列化的表格被编码成密集的嵌入,L2-正态化,并参照所有训练实例计算出余弦相似性。 选择了最近的- k k 邻居来构建内文本示例 。

blocks.en: Nested retrieval was employed so that larger prompt configurations always contained the demonstrations used by smaller configurations.
blocks.zh: 采用了Nested检索,这样,更大的即时配置总是包含较小的配置所使用的演示.

blocks.en: C.3 Inference Hyperparameters
blocks.zh: C.3 推论超参数

blocks.en: Table 7 summarizes the generation parameters used for LLaDA inference.
blocks.zh: 表7概述了LLaDA推论所用的生成参数。

blocks.en: Table 7: Inference hyperparameters used for pretrained LLaDA.
blocks.zh: 表7:预训LLaDA使用的推论超参数。

blocks.en: All experiments were executed with a fixed random seed in order to ensure deterministic retrieval and generation whenever possible.
blocks.zh: 所有实验都用固定的随机种子进行,以确保尽可能进行确定性的检索和生成。

blocks.en: C.4 QLoRA Fine-Tuning
blocks.zh: C.4 QLORA 精选

blocks.en: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning was performed using QLoRA. Only low-rank adaptation matrices were optimized while the pretrained model weights remained frozen. This considerably reduced the memory requirements while preserving the ability to adapt the model to the ToTTo task.
blocks.zh: 使用QLORA进行了参数效率微调。 仅优化了低等级的适应矩阵,而预先训练的模型重量仍然处于冻结状态。 这大大降低了内存要求,同时保留了使模型适应TOTTo任务的能力.

blocks.en: Table 8 reports the training hyperparameters.
blocks.zh: 表8报告了培训超参数。

blocks.en: Table 8: QLoRA fine-tuning hyperparameters.
blocks.zh: 表8:QLORA微调超参数.

blocks.en: C.5 Hardware
blocks.zh: C.5 硬件

blocks.en: All experiments were conducted on a single NVIDIA RTX 4050 Laptop GPU. Diffusion inference for LLaDA was performed using 8-bit quantization together with automatic CPU offloading in order to fit the 8B model within the available GPU memory. The retrieval encoder and evaluation metrics were executed on the same hardware.
blocks.zh: 所有实验都是在单NVIDIA RTX 4050笔记本电脑GPU上进行的. LLaDA的传播推论是使用8位的量子化与自动CPU卸载一起进行的,以便将8B模型装入可用的GPU内存中. 在同一硬件上执行了检索编码器和评价度量衡。

blocks.en: The source code fixes the random seed to 42 and uses identical retrieval examples across all compared models, ensuring that the language model itself remains the only experimental variable.
blocks.zh: 源代码将随机种子修正为42,并使用所有比较模型的相同检索实例,确保语言模型本身仍然是唯一的实验变量.

blocks.en: Appendix D Evaluation Metrics
blocks.zh: 附录D 评价计量

blocks.en: Generation quality is evaluated using complementary metrics measuring lexical overlap, semantic similarity, diversity and factual consistency. All metrics are computed on the evaluation set using identical prediction files for every model.
blocks.zh: 利用衡量词汇重叠、语义相似性、多样性和事实一致性的补充指标来评价生成质量。 所有衡量标准都使用每个模型相同的预测文件在评价组上计算。

blocks.en: D.1 BLEU
blocks.zh: D.1 溴化铀

blocks.en: We report SacreBLEU, which computes modified n n -gram precision together with a brevity penalty. Higher BLEU indicates greater lexical agreement between the generated description and the reference.
blocks.zh: 我们报告SacreBLEU,它计算了修改后的n -g 精度,以及一个短暂的处罚。 较高的BLEU表示生成的描述与参考文献之间有更大的词汇上的协议.

blocks.en: D.2 ROUGE
blocks.zh: D.2 罗马尼亚

blocks.en: We report ROUGE-L, which measures the longest common subsequence (LCS) shared by the generated and reference descriptions. Higher values indicate better structural agreement.
blocks.zh: 我们报告ROUGE-L,它测量生成和参考描述所共有的最长的共同子序列。 较高的数值表明结构上更一致。

blocks.en: D.3 BERTScore
blocks.zh: D.3 伯氏分数

blocks.en: BERTScore evaluates semantic similarity using contextual embeddings from a pretrained Transformer encoder. We report the F1 score averaged over the evaluation set. Higher values indicate stronger semantic similarity.
blocks.zh: BERTScore使用前置变形器编码器的上下文嵌入来评价语义相似性. 我们报告F1的得分平均高于评价组。 较高的数值表明语义相似性较强.

blocks.en: D.4 Self-BLEU
blocks.zh: D.4 自负盈亏

blocks.en: Self-BLEU measures generation diversity by treating each generated description as a hypothesis and all remaining generations as references.
blocks.zh: 自负载测量生成多样性,将每个生成的描述作为假设,并将所有剩余的几代作为参考。

blocks.en: SelfBLEU = 1 N ​ ∑ i = 1 N BLEU ⁡ ( g i , { g j } j ≠ i ) . \mathrm{SelfBLEU}=\frac{1}{N}\sum_{i=1}^{N}\mathrm{BLEU}\left(g_{i},\{g_{j}\}_{j\neq i}\right).
blocks.zh: selfBLEU = 1 N = i = 1 N BLEU = (g i, { g j } j i ). \ mathrm { selfBLEU{ frac { 1} { N}\sum{i = 1}}\ { mathrm{ BLEU} 左( g_{i} ) ,\ g_{j}\}_{j\q i}\right 。

blocks.en: Lower Self-BLEU indicates greater diversity, whereas higher values suggest repetitive outputs.
blocks.zh: 自负盈亏表明多样性较大,而高值表明产出重复。

blocks.en: D.5 Natural Language Inference
blocks.zh: D.5 自然语言推论

blocks.en:
To assess source faithfulness, we employ a Natural Language Inference
(NLI) model. The serialized source table is treated as the premise
and the generated description as the hypothesis. We report the mean
entailment and contradiction probabilities over the evaluation set.
blocks.zh:
为了评估来源的忠诚度,我们采用了自然语言推论
(NLI)型号. 序列式源表作为前提处理
和生成的描述作为假设. 我们报告恶毒的
(a) 涉及评价的概率和矛盾。

blocks.en:
Higher entailment indicates that the generated content is better
supported by the source table, whereas higher contradiction indicates
stronger factual inconsistency with the structured input. Unlike
reference-based metrics, this formulation directly evaluates whether
the information expressed by the generation is supported by its
source.
blocks.zh:
更高的内涵表明生成的内容更好
由源表支持,而较高的矛盾表示
(c) 与结构化投入在事实上更加不一致。 与
基于参考的衡量标准,该表述直接评价是否
一代人表达的信息有其
来源.

blocks.en: D.6 Complementary Evaluation
blocks.zh: D.6 补充评价

blocks.en: Each metric captures a different aspect of generation quality. BLEU and ROUGE evaluate lexical overlap, BERTScore measures semantic similarity, Self-BLEU quantifies output diversity, and NLI estimates factual consistency. Their combination provides a more complete assessment than any individual metric alone and supports the analysis presented in Section 3.
blocks.zh: 每个度量法捕捉到生成质量的不同方面. BLEU和ROUGE评价词汇重叠,BERTScore测量语义相似性,Self-BLEU将输出多样性量化,NLI估计实际一致性. 它们的组合比任何单个衡量标准都提供了更完整的评估,并支持第3节提出的分析。

blocks.en:

Sagar Alias Jacky in the film Irupatham Noottandu.

电影"伊鲁派坦姆·诺坦杜"中的萨加尔·阿利亚斯·杰克(Sagar Alias Jacky).

blocks.en:
LLaDA + QLoRA (5-shot): In 1987, Suresh Rajikumar played the role of
Sagar Alias Jacky in the film Irupatham Noottandu.
blocks.zh:
LLADA + QLORA (5发子弹): 1987年,苏雷什·拉吉库马尔(英语:Suresh Rajikumar)出演了以下角色:
电影"伊鲁派坦姆·诺坦杜"中的萨加尔·阿利亚斯·杰克(Sagar Alias Jacky).

blocks.en:
Both generations preserve the year, film title, and role, but
introduce an unsupported actor identity. LLaDA substitutes
“Sivaji Ganesan” for the reference actor Mohanlal, while
LLaDA+QLoRA generates “Suresh Rajikumar.” The source table itself
does not provide an actor name, making both additions unsupported.
The source-grounded NLI evaluation accordingly assigns contradiction
probabilities above 0.999 to both generations. This case illustrates
a characteristic localized factual error: the generation remains
topically and structurally aligned with the table while introducing
a specific unsupported entity.
blocks.zh:
